capabilities: Substitute quotes, dashes, ellipses, arrows and math symbols as you type
Keep substitutions out of code, formulas, wikilinks, frontmatter, HTML and URLs
Restore the originally typed characters with Backspace after a substitution
Apply typography to an existing selection or the whole note
Set quotation-mark conventions per note, folder or language
disambiguation: Not a font or text-appearance plugin; it rewrites characters as they are typed, it does not change how text looks.
extras: Very thorough README covering edge cases (input methods, iOS Smart Punctuation, table delimiter rows), 130 tests, and a catalog of the author's other plugins and paid Pro extras, which do not concern this plugin.
intentEvidence: The plugin it replaces, mgmeyers/obsidian-smart-typography, has about 170,000 downloads
motivation: The predecessor plugin (obsidian-smart-typography) has had no release since June 2022, and its open issues serve as the specification for this rebuild.
problem: Obsidian's editor inserts only the literal characters typed, and naive smart-punctuation substitutions would break code blocks, queries, wikilinks and frontmatter.

relations.evidence: The plugin it replaces, mgmeyers/obsidian-smart-typography, has about 170,000 downloads

summary: Typing assistant that converts quotes, dashes, ellipses, arrows and math symbols to typographic characters as you type, keeping out of code, links and frontmatter.
